summary: The brothers stand inside Grisha's past and find Eren already there. What the father did in the cave was pushed by a memory that had not happened yet.

segments.ja: 兄弟は、グリシャの時間の中に立っています。立っている場所は、壁の内側の礼拝堂です。礼拝堂の下に、レイス家が始祖を隠していました。隠していた相手は、フリーダです。フリーダは王家の血と、始祖の力を同時に持っています。持っている力は、不戦の誓いで戦争へ向きません。向かない力を、父は受け取ろうとして足を止めます。止めた足の先に、未来の息子がすでに立っています。
segments.en: The brothers are standing inside Grisha's time. The place they are standing is a chapel inside the walls. Under the chapel, the Reiss family had hidden the Founder. The person who had hidden it was Frieda. Frieda holds royal blood and the Founder's power at the same time. The power she holds does not turn toward war, because of a vow to renounce it. The father, trying to receive the power that does not turn, stops his feet. A son from ahead is already standing beyond the feet that stopped.

segments.ja: フリーダは、壁の外の脅威を知っています。知っていても、始祖をその脅威へ向けることができません。できない理由は、王家の誓いが手を止める、です。止める姿を、ジークは父の暴力の前の無力として見ます。見る無力は、安楽死以外では始祖が動かないという兄の根拠です。根拠の横で、エレンはフリーダの目を見ています。見ている目は、命令に縛られた人の目です。
segments.en: Frieda knows the threat outside the walls. Even knowing it, she cannot aim the Founder at that threat. The reason she cannot is that the royal vow stops her hands. Zeke sees the form that stops as powerlessness before the father's violence. The powerlessness he sees is the older brother's ground for saying the Founder does not move except for euthanasia. Beside that ground, Eren is looking at Frieda's eyes. The eyes he is looking at are the eyes of a person bound by an order.

segments.ja: ロッドは、レイス家の当主としてその場にいます。いる当主は、自分では始祖を継ぎません。継がないまま、娘に世界の形を預けています。預けた娘が父に対して動けないとき、彼は跪きます。跪く理由は、戦いではなく、血の儀式が崩れる恐怖です。恐怖を、ジークは王家の弱さとして処理します。処理する兄の横で、弟は跪く男を父の障害としては見ていません。
segments.en: Rod is there as the head of the Reiss family. The head who is there does not inherit the Founder himself. Without inheriting it, he has entrusted the shape of the world to his daughter. When the daughter he entrusted cannot move against the father, he kneels. The reason he kneels is not a fight. It is the fear that the ritual of blood will collapse. Zeke processes the fear as the weakness of the royal family. Beside the older brother who processes it, the younger brother is not looking at the kneeling man as his father's obstacle.

segments.en: Grisha, with a doctor's hands, cannot hold the blade. The reason he cannot is that the family in front of him includes children. He knows that bringing that family down is the next step of restoration. Even knowing it, his feet stay on the floor. Zeke feels, for the first time, that the father who stays there is close to himself. The closeness he feels is that the father too is a human who cannot hurt children. In the moment he thinks that, the father inside the memory turns around.

segments.ja: 振り返ったグリシャの視線の先に、エレンがいます。いるエレンは、この時間ではまだ子供です。子供であるはずの時刻に、父は未来の息子を見ています。見ていることは、記憶が過去だけではない、です。ではない方向から、誰かが父の背中を押します。押す存在を、ジークは最初理解できません。理解できない押しかたの主が、隣にいる弟だと後で分かります。
segments.en: At the end of the gaze of Grisha, who turned, Eren is there. The Eren who is there is still a child in this time. At the hour when he should be a child, the father is seeing a son from ahead. What he is seeing means the memory is not only the past. It is not. From the direction that is not the past, someone pushes the father's back. At first Zeke cannot understand the presence that pushes. Later he understands that the one who pushes in that way is the younger brother beside him.

segments.en: The Eren from ahead presses his father, without a speech, to go forward. The content of the pressing is that if the Founder is left here, the people inside the walls end. The father has already been shown the future that ends. With the fear he was shown, the hands that had stopped begin to move. Zeke had thought the responsibility of the moving hands was the father's personal cruelty. Part of the cruelty he had thought is the will of a younger brother who had not been born yet. The older brother who saw the will cannot revise the story of the grass. He sees the story he cannot revise in his younger brother's face.

segments.ja: ジークは、記憶の中の父に呼びかけます。呼びかける内容は、やるな、です。です、が、過去の父には兄の声が届きません。届かない代わりに、未来の弟の圧だけが届いています。届いている圧を、ジークは自分の敗北として見ます。見る敗北は、父が弱い人間だったという証明が崩れる、です。崩れる証明のあと、父は礼拝堂で始祖を受け取ります。受け取る詳細を、今日の話は手順にしません。
segments.en: Zeke calls to the father inside the memory. The content of the call is: do not do it. But the older brother's voice does not reach the father of the past. In place of not reaching, only the pressure of the younger brother from ahead is reaching. Zeke sees the pressure that is reaching as his own defeat. The defeat he sees is that the proof of the father being a weak human collapses. After the proof collapses, the father receives the Founder in the chapel. Today's story does not turn the detail of receiving into a procedure.

segments.en: At the edge of the memory, Kruger's name is there as one thread. The name that is there is the person who passed the Attack Titan to Grisha. When he passed it, he left the words of someone who sees ahead. Inside the words he left, Mikasa's name and Armin's name are there on the side of keeping them alive. Today's story does not turn the names that are there into a quotation. It does not. What it sets down is that the mission the father received was not his revenge alone. The mission that was not that connects to the son from ahead.

segments.en: Dina's name also remains shortly in this memory. The name that remains is Zeke's mother, and the source of the royal blood. The older brother uses the source for the explanation of the key. More than the explanation he uses, what the younger brother is looking at is the father's regret. The regret is losing the first family in Marley, and putting the next family in danger inside the walls. The son from ahead is pushing the father who does that. The composition of pushing was not in the older brother's story. Zeke almost admits the composition that was not there.

segments.titleJa: 壁の未来を見せられる
segments.titleEn: He is shown the walls' future
segments.ja: 父は、まだ来ていない壁の崩れを見せられます。見せられる景色は、巨大な列が外へ歩く、です。歩く理由を、彼は息子の目から受け取ります。受け取る息子は、礼拝堂の時点では生まれてもいない意志です。意志が過去を変えることを、ジークは始祖の不正と呼びます。呼ぶ不正の主は、隣で同じ景色を見ている弟です。見ている弟は、否定しません。否定しないことが、この記憶の核です。核は、父が自分の意志だけで動いたのではない、です。
segments.en: The father is shown a collapse of the walls that has not come yet. The scene he is shown is an enormous row walking outward. He receives the reason for walking from his son's eyes. The son he receives it from is a will that has not even been born at the time of the chapel. Zeke calls it a fraud of the Founder that a will changes the past. The one who owns the fraud he calls is the younger brother looking at the same scene beside him. The younger brother who is looking does not deny it. The not denying is the core of this memory. The core is that the father did not move by his own will alone.

segments.ja: 父が手を動かした理由の一つに、ミカサがいます。いる名は、守るべき未来の子供です。子供の名を、今日の話は長い台詞にはしません。しません。置くのは、父の残虐さが愛の恐怖と混ざっていた、です。混ざっていたことを、ジークは許せません。許せない理由は、自分にはその未来の子供の席がなかった、です。なかった席を、弟は最初から持っていました。持っていた差が、兄弟の記憶を分けます。
segments.en: Mikasa is one reason the father moved his hands. The name that is there is a child of the future who should be protected. Today's story does not turn the child's name into a long speech. It does not. What it sets down is that the father's cruelty was mixed with the fear of love. Zeke cannot forgive that it was mixed. The reason he cannot forgive it is that there was no seat for him among those children of the future. The younger brother held the seat that was not there from the start. The difference he held divides the brothers' memory.

segments.titleEn: Eren was there from the start
segments.ja: この記憶を見終わるとき、構図が反転します。反転するのは、弟が父に影響されたのではなく、父が弟に押された、です。押された時間は、エレンが生まれる前です。前にいる意志が、進撃の巨人の未来を見る性質と重なります。重なる性質を、ジークは制御できる力だと思っていました。思っていた制御は、弟の側にあります。ある制御を、兄は血では奪えません。奪えない差が、二人の距離です。
segments.en: When they finish looking at this memory, the composition reverses. What reverses is that the younger brother was not influenced by the father. The father was pushed by the younger brother. The time of being pushed is before Eren is born. The will that is there before overlaps the Attack Titan's nature of seeing ahead. Zeke had thought the overlapping nature was a power he could control. The control he had thought is on the younger brother's side. The older brother cannot take the control that is there with blood. The difference that cannot be taken is the distance between the two.
